raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely accepted a search snippet (from a non-authoritative genealogical site) indicating Prince William’s paternal grandparents were Frederick II and Princess Mary of Great Britain, and thus inferred the paternal grandmother was Mary. This conflated a great-grandparent with a grandparent and ignored the established lineage that William’s father (Prince Frederick of Hesse-Kassel, 1771–1845) was the son of Charles of Hesse-Kassel and Princess Louise of Denmark and Norway. The error arose from overreliance on an unverified snippet without cross-checking against authoritative sources.
